statement: A forwarded message-group control message reports completion to its original sender only when the leader's completion says so. Found 2026-09-28 while proving c3cfd229f (fixes/mg-forwarded-application-envelope): both forwarders (MessageGroupForwardingOwner.forwardMetadataIngressPayloadToLeader, message-group-forwarding-owner.js:571, and replica-dispatch-readiness-capture.js:759) await sendMessage and ignore the leader's completionKind/completionCompleted, and ReplicaDispatchService.handleMessageReceived then reports completionCompleted:true after any forward, including the forwardedBy loop-guard early return that delivered nothing. One shared place propagates the leader's typed completion; a leader completion of false, a deferred answer, a throw or a loop-guard stop never reaches the sender as completed. Also record the sibling: RPCClient.call rides MessageGroupService.sendMessage and its router handlers (message-group-service-handler.js, replica-handler) read the outer envelope, so its type is always unknown (latent, no src caller).

constraints.statement: Builds on c3cfd229f (forwarded application messages reach the leader's completion handler); lands after it.
Completion propagation lives in one place shared by both forwarders; no per-forwarder copies.
Deterministic red-on-revert witness: leader completion false/deferred/throw and the loop-guard stop each reach the sender as not completed.
